title: Reed Jobs Scraper
description: Collect Reed.co.uk job listings by keyword and location, or start from a Reed search URL.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: A public Reed.co.uk search or job URL. When supplied, the Actor uses this URL instead of the keyword and location fields.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job title, skill, or search phrase, for example "software engineer". Clear this field to search by location alone.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional UK town, city, or region, for example "London".

posted_date.title: Posted date
posted_date.description: Only include jobs posted within this window.

results_wanted.title: Maximum jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to save. Reed exposes at most 10,000 results for one search.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on the number of result pages to read. Each page holds up to 100 jobs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy for larger runs. Leave empty to connect directly.
